name: Akron
housing: Akron's rentals are mostly older single-family houses and duplexes, many built for rubber-factory workers, plus apartments near the University of Akron.

localRules.text: Landlords must register each rental unit with the City of Akron's Housing Code Enforcement.
Summit County also requires a one-time registration of residential rentals with the Fiscal Office.

tenantHelp.name: Community Legal Aid (Right to Counsel Akron)
tenantHelp.what: free lawyers for eligible Akron tenants facing eviction

climate: Test the furnace and check the basement for water; winters are cold and snowy and spring thaw brings damp.
fact: Akron Municipal Court requires landlords to show the property is on the county rental registry before they can file an eviction.
